solutions.title: Recursive inorder gap scan
solutions.strategy: Walk the BST in sorted order and compare each value with the previous value seen.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack grows with tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative inorder stack
solutions.strategy: Use an explicit stack to produce sorted BST values without recursion.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores a root-to-leaf path in a balanced tree and can grow to O(n) when skewed.
